description:
On this episode of DC Studios Showcase: The Official Podcast, hosts Frankey Smith and Coy Jandreau welcome acclaimed DC Comics writers Jeremy Adams and Morgan Hampton for an unforgettable conversation about Green Lantern, Green Lantern Corps, and what it takes to build one of the biggest mythologies in the DC Universe. From Kyle Rayner's return to the challenges of balancing decades of Green Lantern lore, this episode is packed with behind-the-scenes stories, comic book insights, and exclusive looks into how today's DC creators shape the future of the DCU.

Jeremy and Morgan share their journeys from lifelong comic fans to writing some of DC's biggest ongoing series, reveal how fan feedback influences their work, discuss bringing forgotten characters back into continuity, and tease exciting things still to come for Green Lantern fans. On Season 1, Episode 5 of Stuart Fails to Save the Universe Official Podcast, Felicia Day and Wil Wheaton welcome Brian Posehn, who returns as Bert from The Big Bang Theory, plus production designer Valdar Wilt and costume designer Valerie Klarich. They go behind the scenes of “Spoiler: Bert Gets Married,” from Bert’s emotional paradise romance to the enormous village and 50-plus costumes created for the episode.

It’s the fan access we love: Posehn shares why SFTSTU became his favorite job, how Bert began as an unnamed cafeteria character, and what changed when a Big Bang Theory supporting player became a multiverse leading man.
